newsitem.title: UK: Europe's cotton markets see selective spot trade.
newsitem.headline: Europe's cotton markets see selective spot trade.

text.p: The ready availability of virtually all upland descriptions with some highly competitive offers to buyers did little to move Europe's raw cotton markets on Thursday, industry sources said.
Selective buying of Central Asian, African and U.S origins for nearby delivery was seen in Portugal, Italy and Belgium but elsewhere demand was extremely thin.
Sources in Eastern Europe reported featureless trade and a neglected long-staple market.
